title: Kernel Skyline Autotuner: dynamic kernel mix for mixed-length traffic
creator: Aisha Gomez
description: Goal: Implement a lightweight online 'skyline' autotuner that composes a small portfolio of kernels per hardware class (e.g., A100-80GB, T4, GNVX) across sequence-length buckets and runtime phases (prefill vs decode). The tuner should continuously adjust mixture weights based on latency and cost SLOs, with a safety net that falls back to a conservative kernel for tail risk. Deliverables: design doc, offline simulation harness, runtime agent, feature flags, dashboards and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Autotuner runs in the serving runtime under a feature flag with <5% CPU overhead on control plane
p50 latency improvement >= 8% and token-cost reduction >= 6% on mixed-length synthetic workload vs baseline for T4 and A100 in our benchmark pool
No regression (>5% increase) in p99 latency on short-decode heavy traces; safety fallback triggers under anomaly
Metrics exposed: selected_kernel, kernel_weight, probed_cost, fallback_count; dashboards and alerting configured
Can pin to static kernel portfolio via config and disable online exploration
comments: 2026-02-16 - Aisha Gomez: Kicked off scoping. Early design favors a small discrete action space (3 kernels per bucket) to keep probing lightweight. Proposed buckets: short (<=32 tokens), medium (33-512), long (>512).

2026-02-20 - Liam O'Connor: Ran offline trace replay on mixed-customer traces. Observed that prefill favors tiled-attention kernels on A100 for >512, but decode bursts still benefit from fused-causal kernels for short sequences. Need hybrid portfolio per phase.

2026-02-25 - Priya Malhotra (SRE): Telemetry hooks requested: selected_kernel, latency_ms, tokens_generated, weight_vector. Also add a counter for fallback activations to help on-call understand regressions.

2026-03-01 - Liam O'Connor: Implemented simulation harness and ran 48-hour bandit run (epsilon-greedy with decaying epsilon). Results: T4 mixed-workload p50 down 12%, cost per token down 7%; however short-decode p99 increased 4.8% in worst-case—within threshold but close. Added shorter safety probing windows for decode-phase.
2026-03-03 - Design review (Shen Li): UX: need a console toggle for per-customer exploration budget and a visual of kernel skyline per region. Added task to Console backlog.

2026-03-05 - QA (Marisol Reyes): Integration tests added. Reproduced experiment with synthetic bursts: fallback logic invoked correctly when p99 drift exceeded configured margin. Ready for canary rollout behind feature flag.
implementation_notes: Tuner design: maintain online exponential moving averages of latency and cost per kernel per bucket and phase. Score = latency_penalty * p50 + tail_penalty * p99 + lambda * cost. Use lightweight controller to reweight kernel mixture every minute with probe budget of 0.5% of requests. Probes should be stratified by customer priority and region. Ensure KV cache compatibility when switching kernels mid-request by only switching between kernel variants that share compatible KV layout.
rollout_plan: 1) Lab experiments (done); 2) Canary: 5% of non-critical traffic in us-west on T4/A100 pools for 72h; 3) Expand to 25% with stricter alerting; 4) Gradual global ramp if metrics stable. Circuit breaker: revert to static kernel if fallback_count > threshold or p99 increases >5% for 1h.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: kernel switch may be incompatible with cached KV formats and cause correctness or perf cliffs. Mitigation: restrict mix to kernels flagged as KV-compatible or perform warmstart replay. Risk: noisy exploration harms SLOs. Mitigation: low probe budget, per-customer opt-out, and immediate fallback on anomalies.
perf_summary: Simulation (2026-03-01): mixed-1000-trace: T4 p50 -12%, p95 -6%, p99 +2.1%; A100 p50 -9%, cost -6.5%. Short-decode burst scenario: p99 +4.8% before adding safety window; after safety window tuning, p99 delta reduced to +1.2%.
next_steps: Merge PR for runtime agent (GH#7891), add Grafana panels for kernel_weight and probe_rate, create console feature toggle, coordinate canary with SRE for 2026-03-10.
